effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may link 1 level 3 Digimon card from your hand or this Digimon's digivolution cards to this Digimon without paying the cost.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, it can't be deleted in battle until your opponent's turn ends.
